Definition: Integration with national payment systems for government-to-person (G2P), government-to-business (G2B) transactions via data exchange
Comments: MICSTI is developing a government e-payments gateway under the eGovernment Infrastructure Phase II Project. The planned gateway will cover passports, registrations, agricultural subsidies, driver's licenses, and health services. Status is planning.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Upgraded from Planned (2) to Under development (3). The World Bank's Public Sector Foundations for Service Delivery Project confirms AfDB co-financing is actively developing an e-payment gateway, the World Bank Competitiveness and Financial Inclusion Project describes concrete design/implementation of a G2B payment gateway, and the Central Bank-led LeSwitch national payment switch officially launched its first phase in March 2024 — together showing implementation activity beyond mere planning.

Definition: Integration of social assistance programs, grant registries, beneficiary management systems
Comments: The 50-in-5 profile notes DPI will enable digital payments of social grants. Ministry of LGCHAP has an MoU with NIR equivalents linking ID to social protection. Integration into a data exchange platform is planned.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Upgraded from Planned (2) to Under development (3). World Bank reporting on Lesotho's National ID system confirms NISSA (the social registry, covering ~90% of households) has engaged a consulting firm to build APIs for automated data exchange with the NID system, describing the work as 'still at a preliminary stage', and a EU/UNICEF-funded upgrade of NISSA/MISSA is under way explicitly targeting interoperability with the NICR and CRVS systems.
